alt: An array of next-indices with a slow pointer moving one step at a time and a fast pointer moving two steps at a time. If fast ever lands on the same index as slow, the sequence contains a cycle, and walking forward from that meeting point back to itself gives the cycle's length. If fast runs off the end of the sequence first, there is no cycle.

steps.caption: slow and fast both start at index 0.
slow moves one step, from 0 to 1. fast moves two steps, from 0 to 2. Not the same index yet.
slow moves one step, from 1 to 2. fast moves two steps, from 2 to 1. Not the same index yet.
slow moves one step, from 2 to 3. fast moves two steps, from 1 to 3. They land on the same index: a cycle exists, met at index 3.
Walking forward from the meeting point back to itself takes 3 steps: the cycle length is 3.
slow and fast both start at index 0.
slow moves one step, from 0 to 1. fast moves two steps, from 0 to 2. Not the same index yet.
slow moves one step, from 1 to 2. fast moves two steps, from 2 to -1. Not the same index yet.
fast is at index past the end: the next step runs off the sequence. There is no cycle to find.
slow and fast both start at index 0.
slow moves one step, from 0 to 0. fast moves two steps, from 0 to 0. They land on the same index: a cycle exists, met at index 0.
Walking forward from the meeting point back to itself takes 1 step: the cycle length is 1.
